structured_output.analysis: The only measured grid is iso_3.15: KL 0.4361 [E514ab09c524e], at 3.148 average bits, which uses the whole budget. Every bit-raising move therefore has to be paid for by a downgrade somewhere else. The records only give per-layer numbers for the layers where loss concentrates, and for those, dropping from 3 bits to 2 costs about 0.02 KL each (for example layers.3.up_proj, rht_gptq_int3 0.0064 vs rht_gptq_int2 0.0302). That is far more than the roughly 0.0035 gained by moving layers.27.up_proj or layers.27.gate_proj to 4 bits. I have no record of a layer that is cheap to downgrade, so I am not proposing any trades of bits between layers this round. The per-layer method choices also look right: for layers.27.up_proj and layers.2.up_proj, gptq_int3 already beats rht_gptq_int3. The changes that cost no bits are the GPTQ algorithm settings: act_order, the damping value (damp) and block_size. All recipes so far used the defaults. So this round tests those settings without changing any layer's method.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: Base iso_3.15 measured KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] with default options. The largest single-layer losses are from GPTQ at 2-3 bits: layers.27.up_proj gptq_int3 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded], layers.14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065], layers.3.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.0064177 [E6f4f7ea296d5]. These layers have heavy-tailed activations (activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a]). Setting act_order=true makes GPTQ process the columns with the most activation energy first and costs no stored bits, so the size is unchanged.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp005
proposals.rationale: Same methods as iso_3.15, whose KL measured 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e], so the size is unchanged. This adds act_order=true and lowers the damping to damp=0.005, which makes GPTQ follow the measured Hessian more closely. The losses targeted are layers.1.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.00611131 [E0564bc6ad1eb] and layers.27.gate_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.00498703 [Efa0bb391da67].

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_bs64
proposals.rationale: Same methods as iso_3.15, measured KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e], so no bits change. This tests act_order=true together with block_size=64; block_size only changes how GPTQ batches its error updates, not the stored size. The targets are the 2-bit GPTQ layers, such as layers.14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065] against rht_gptq_int3 0.00181478 [E90bd4b2f3645].
